ONE-TIME SETUP (DO THIS FIRST)

Create an app at discord.com/developers/applications, add a Bot, copy its token.
In Vercel, set env vars: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN, DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID, DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY.
In the app's "General Information" tab, set Interactions Endpoint URL to your site's /api/discord/interactions.
Invite the bot to your server with the bot + applications.commands scopes and Manage Roles / Send Messages / Embed Links permissions.
Drag the bot's own role ABOVE any tier role below in Server Settings → Roles, or role grants will silently fail.
Fill in the IDs below (Discord → enable Developer Mode → right-click a channel/role → Copy ID), then Save, then Register Commands.

Home
SlipSurge
About SlipSurge

The social hub for sports & picks.

What we're building
SlipSurge is a place to follow sports bettors the way you'd follow anyone else worth listening to — real graded records, real picks, real parlays, not screenshots that vanish the moment they're wrong. Post a pick, build a parlay with same-book odds and payout math built in, and follow cappers whose track record you can actually verify on their profile.
The Sideline · NFL
Follow NFL matchups, compare player props and ladders, and research the slate in The Sideline.
The Court · NBA
Compare NBA odds and alternate lines, explore player trends and defense by position, and build your research in The Court.
Your sports, together
Follow NFL and NBA teams and players, share picks and stories, and open live scores, box scores and play-by-play from one community. Ultimate includes both research workspaces.
Not a sportsbook
SlipSurge is a social and content platform. We don't accept wagers or process bets — any odds or payout numbers you see on a post are self-reported by the user who posted it. See our Responsible Gambling page for more.

SlipSurge
FAQ
Is SlipSurge a sportsbook? Can I place real bets here?
No. SlipSurge is a social platform for sharing and following picks — we never accept wagers or hold funds for betting. Place actual bets through a licensed sportsbook in your jurisdiction.
What are the wager/payout numbers on a pick or parlay?
Self-reported by the user who posted it, using the calculator built into the composer. They're not verified against, or connected to, any real sportsbook account.
How does parlay grading work?
Each leg grades independently against the final box score. A parlay only shows WIN once every leg has graded — any single loss fails the whole thing, all-push is a push, otherwise it's a win, same as a real sportsbook slip.
Why can I only parlay legs from the same sportsbook?
Real books only pay out combined odds within their own platform — you can't parlay a leg priced on FanDuel with one priced on BetMGM. SlipSurge enforces the same rule so the combined odds shown are actually correct.
What's free vs. what requires a paid membership?
The NBA preview and NFL preview are open to everyone. A free account lets you follow the feed and manage your profile and favorites. Ultimate unlocks full-slate odds, more markets, and research tools.
How do creator subscriptions work?
Approved creators can publish paid memberships and one-time offers through Whop. SlipSurge collects the displayed platform fee, while creator balances, verification, and withdrawals are managed securely through Whop.
How do I connect Whop, Discord, or X after signing up?
Open Connected accounts in Settings. You can add or remove any supported account there, even if you originally signed up with email or a different provider.
How do I delete my account?
Open Account settings and use the account deletion option. You can contact support if you cannot sign in.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 29, 2026 · SlipSurge LLC

On this page
1. Overview
2. Information We Collect
3. How We Use Your Information
4. How We Share Information
5. Public & Shared Content
6. Cookies & Similar Technologies
7. Third-Party Services We Use
8. Your Privacy Choices & Rights
9. Data Retention & Deletion
10. Data Security
11. Children's Privacy
12. International Users
13. Changes to This Policy
14. Contact Us
1. Overview
This policy describes how SlipSurge LLC ("SlipSurge," "we," "us") collects, uses, shares, and protects information when you use slipsurge.com and our mobile apps (together, the "Service"). It applies to every visitor and account holder. By using the Service, you agree to the practices described here.
2. Information We Collect

Account information. Email address, username, password (stored as a salted hash, never in plain text), and profile details you choose to add (display name, bio, avatar/banner image).

Sign-in via a third-party provider. If you register or sign in through a supported third-party identity provider, we receive your account ID, username, and public profile photo from that provider so we can create and authenticate your SlipSurge account. We don't receive your password for that provider and can't post to it on your behalf beyond what you explicitly connect.

Content you create. Posts, comments, picks, parlays, Custom Matrices, watchlist entries, and any other content you submit.

Billing information. Subscriptions and creator payments are processed by Whop. We receive your tier, subscription status, and renewal dates from Whop. We never see or store your full card number.

Device & usage data. IP address, browser/device type, pages viewed, and general usage patterns, collected automatically to keep the Service working and secure. If you enable push notifications, we store the device token needed to deliver them.

Information we do not collect. We don't collect your sportsbook account credentials, betting history from any sportsbook, bank account or full payment card numbers, or Social Security number.

3. How We Use Your Information
We use the information above to: create and secure your account; show you your feed, picks, and Dugout research tools; grade picks against public game data; process and manage your subscription; send account-related notifications (security alerts, billing receipts, password changes) and, if you opt in, push notifications about picks or activity; respond to support requests; and detect abuse, fraud, or violations of our Terms of Service. We do not sell your personal information to third parties, and we do not use your data to place, facilitate, or influence any real-money wager.
4. How We Share Information
We share information only in these situations: with service providers who process it on our behalf under their own confidentiality obligations (see Section 7); when you make content public per your own visibility settings; to comply with a legal obligation, subpoena, or valid government request; to protect the rights, property, or safety of SlipSurge, our users, or the public; or with your consent. We do not share your information with advertisers or data brokers for their own marketing purposes.
5. Public & Shared Content
Picks, parlays, comments, and posts you create are visible to other users according to the visibility setting you choose for that content — public, followers-only, or private. Your username, avatar, and (unless you enable the hide-win-rate setting) your posted win/loss record are visible on your public profile. Anything you post publicly can be viewed, and potentially re-shared, by anyone — don't post information you wouldn't want to be public.
6. Cookies & Similar Technologies
We use strictly necessary cookies to keep you signed in and to remember basic preferences (like your light/dark theme choice). We do not currently use third-party advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. If that changes, we'll update this section and, where required, ask for your consent first.
7. Third-Party Services We Use

Running SlipSurge means relying on a handful of specialized providers, each of which processes a slice of your data under its own privacy practices:

Authentication, database, and file storage — a third-party provider handles account authentication and stores your account and content data on our behalf.
Subscription billing, creator payments, and membership management are provided by Whop.
Application hosting and delivery — a third-party cloud hosting provider.
Official league data — game schedules, box scores, player bios, and official player headshots/team logos are pulled from a public sports-league data source to power research tools like the Dugout and Slate Breakdown. This is public league data, not information about you.
Sports-data aggregation and public sportsbook lines — we aggregate publicly posted betting odds from major U.S. sportsbooks for display in our research tools, via a third-party sports-data aggregator. SlipSurge is not affiliated with, and does not share your data with, any sportsbook.

Each provider only receives the data it needs to perform its function for us — none of them is authorized to use your data for their own independent purposes.

8. Your Privacy Choices & Rights
Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, export, or delete your personal information, and to object to or restrict certain processing. You can update most account details yourself in Settings, or email support@slipsurge.com for anything else, including a full data export or deletion request. We'll respond within a reasonable time and verify your identity before acting on the request.
9. Data Retention & Deletion
We keep your account data for as long as your account is active, plus a limited period afterward in case you return or a legal/tax obligation requires it. When you delete your account, we delete or anonymize your personal information within a reasonable timeframe, except data we're required to retain by law (e.g. billing records) or that's embedded in another user's content (e.g. a reply to your comment) — that record stays, attributed to a deleted account.
10. Data Security
We use industry-standard safeguards — encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS), hashed passwords, and row-level database access controls that scope every query to the requesting user — to protect your information. No system is 100% secure, so we can't guarantee absolute security. Use a strong, unique password and enable any additional account protection we offer.
11. Children's Privacy
SlipSurge is not directed at, and is not intended for use by, anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18. If we learn we've collected information from a user under 18, we'll delete it. If you believe a child has provided us information, contact support@slipsurge.com.
12. International Users
SlipSurge is operated from the United States and our servers and service providers are primarily based there. If you access the Service from outside the U.S., your information will be transferred to and processed in the U.S., where privacy laws may differ from those in your home country.
13. Changes to This Policy
We may update this policy as the product evolves. If we make a material change, we'll update the "Last updated" date above and, where appropriate, notify you directly. Continued use of the Service after a change means you accept the updated policy.
14. Contact Us
SlipSurge LLC · support@slipsurge.com
Questions about this policy, or a request to access, export, or delete your data, can go to the address above.

Responsible Gambling

Last updated: July 29, 2026 · SlipSurge LLC

SlipSurge is a social and research platform, not a sportsbook. We don't accept wagers, hold funds for betting, or process bets of any kind. Nothing on this site is betting advice or a guarantee of any outcome.
On this page
1. Overview
2. Betting Responsibly
3. Picks & Records Are Not Advice
4. Warning Signs of a Gambling Problem
5. Self-Exclusion Programs
6. Get Help
7. Age Requirement
8. Contact Us
1. Overview
Sports betting can be entertaining when it's done within limits you've set for yourself. This page exists because SlipSurge's community is built around real-money betting culture, even though we ourselves never touch a real wager — and we'd rather you have this information in front of you than assume you've already found it elsewhere.
2. Betting Responsibly
Only bet with licensed, regulated sportsbooks operating legally in your jurisdiction.
Set a budget before you start, and never bet more than you can afford to lose — regardless of what you see posted on SlipSurge or anywhere else.
Set a time limit for how long you'll engage with betting activity in a given session.
Never chase losses by increasing your stakes to win back money you've already lost.
Don't bet under the influence of alcohol or other substances that impair judgment.
Treat betting as entertainment you're paying for, not as a source of income.
Take regular breaks, and don't let betting activity crowd out other parts of your life.
Most licensed sportsbooks offer deposit limits, loss limits, and cool-off/self-exclusion tools directly in their app — use them if you have any doubt about your own limits.
3. Picks & Records Are Not Advice
A user's win/loss record, a hot streak, or a confident-sounding post is not a guarantee of anything. Past results — a user's, or a Custom Matrix's historical hit rate — don't predict future outcomes. Every pick, take, or Matrix result on this platform reflects one person's (or one saved rule's) opinion or history, not financial or betting advice, and SlipSurge doesn't verify that any of it is accurate before it's posted.
4. Warning Signs of a Gambling Problem

Consider stepping back and reaching out for support if you notice yourself:

Betting more money or more often than you intended to;
Lying to family or friends about how much time or money you're spending on betting;
Chasing losses, or betting to escape stress, anxiety, or other problems;
Borrowing money, missing bills, or going into debt to fund betting;
Feeling restless or irritable when trying to cut back or stop; or
Neglecting work, school, relationships, or responsibilities because of betting.

Any one of these on its own is worth paying attention to — you don't need to hit a breaking point before it's worth reaching out for help.

5. Self-Exclusion Programs
If you want to stop yourself from being able to bet, most states run a self-exclusion program that bars you from licensed sportsbooks and casinos statewide — a stronger step than closing an individual sportsbook account, since it's enforced across every licensed operator in that state. The National Council on Problem Gambling maintains a directory of state-by-state self-exclusion programs at ncpgambling.org/help-treatment/self-exclusion.
6. Get Help

If you or someone you know is struggling with gambling, free, confidential help is available 24/7:

Call: 1-800-GAMBLER (1-800-426-2537), the national helpline promoted by the American Gaming Association and most U.S. sportsbooks.
Call or text: 1-800-MY-RESET (1-800-697-3738), the National Problem Gambling Helpline — call, text, or chat, 24/7/365.
Online: ncpgambling.org for chat support and state-by-state resources.
Peer support: gamblersanonymous.org for local Gamblers Anonymous meetings.
7. Age Requirement
You must be at least 18 to create a SlipSurge account. If you intend to place a real-money wager based on anything you see here, you're responsible for confirming you meet the minimum legal age for sports betting in your own jurisdiction — 21 in most U.S. states, and potentially different elsewhere.
8. Contact Us
SlipSurge LLC · support@slipsurge.com

We do our best to keep this data accurate and current, but we don't control these sources and can't guarantee their accuracy, availability, or timeliness. SlipSurge is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by any sports league, club, or sportsbook referenced on the Service.

Nothing on SlipSurge — including picks, records, win rates, Custom Matrix results, or odds data — is financial, investment, or betting advice, and none of it guarantees any outcome. A user's past performance, however it's displayed, does not predict future results. If you choose to bet, do so only with a licensed, regulated sportsbook in your jurisdiction, and only with money you can afford to lose. See our Responsible Gambling page.

SlipSurge
About SlipSurge

The social hub for sports & picks.

What we're building
SlipSurge is a place to follow sports bettors the way you'd follow anyone else worth listening to — real graded records, real picks, real parlays, not screenshots that vanish the moment they're wrong. Post a pick, build a parlay with same-book odds and payout math built in, and follow cappers whose track record you can actually verify on their profile.
The Sideline · NFL
Follow NFL matchups, compare player props and ladders, and research the slate in The Sideline.
The Court · NBA
Compare NBA odds and alternate lines, explore player trends and defense by position, and build your research in The Court.
Your sports, together
Follow NFL and NBA teams and players, share picks and stories, and open live scores, box scores and play-by-play from one community. Ultimate includes both research workspaces.
Not a sportsbook
SlipSurge is a social and content platform. We don't accept wagers or process bets — any odds or payout numbers you see on a post are self-reported by the user who posted it. See our Responsible Gambling page for more.

FAQ
Is SlipSurge a sportsbook? Can I place real bets here?
No. SlipSurge is a social platform for sharing and following picks — we never accept wagers or hold funds for betting. Place actual bets through a licensed sportsbook in your jurisdiction.
What are the wager/payout numbers on a pick or parlay?
Self-reported by the user who posted it, using the calculator built into the composer. They're not verified against, or connected to, any real sportsbook account.
How does parlay grading work?
Each leg grades independently against the final box score. A parlay only shows WIN once every leg has graded — any single loss fails the whole thing, all-push is a push, otherwise it's a win, same as a real sportsbook slip.
Why can I only parlay legs from the same sportsbook?
Real books only pay out combined odds within their own platform — you can't parlay a leg priced on FanDuel with one priced on BetMGM. SlipSurge enforces the same rule so the combined odds shown are actually correct.
What's free vs. what requires a paid membership?
The NBA preview and NFL preview are open to everyone. A free account lets you follow the feed and manage your profile and favorites. Ultimate unlocks full-slate odds, more markets, and research tools.
How do creator subscriptions work?
Approved creators can publish paid memberships and one-time offers through Whop. SlipSurge collects the displayed platform fee, while creator balances, verification, and withdrawals are managed securely through Whop.
How do I connect Whop, Discord, or X after signing up?
Open Connected accounts in Settings. You can add or remove any supported account there, even if you originally signed up with email or a different provider.
How do I delete my account?
Open Account settings and use the account deletion option. You can contact support if you cannot sign in.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 29, 2026 · SlipSurge LLC

1. Overview
This policy describes how SlipSurge LLC ("SlipSurge," "we," "us") collects, uses, shares, and protects information when you use slipsurge.com and our mobile apps (together, the "Service"). It applies to every visitor and account holder. By using the Service, you agree to the practices described here.
2. Information We Collect

Account information. Email address, username, password (stored as a salted hash, never in plain text), and profile details you choose to add (display name, bio, avatar/banner image).

Sign-in via a third-party provider. If you register or sign in through a supported third-party identity provider, we receive your account ID, username, and public profile photo from that provider so we can create and authenticate your SlipSurge account. We don't receive your password for that provider and can't post to it on your behalf beyond what you explicitly connect.

Content you create. Posts, comments, picks, parlays, Custom Matrices, watchlist entries, and any other content you submit.

Billing information. Subscriptions and creator payments are processed by Whop. We receive your tier, subscription status, and renewal dates from Whop. We never see or store your full card number.

Device & usage data. IP address, browser/device type, pages viewed, and general usage patterns, collected automatically to keep the Service working and secure. If you enable push notifications, we store the device token needed to deliver them.

Information we do not collect. We don't collect your sportsbook account credentials, betting history from any sportsbook, bank account or full payment card numbers, or Social Security number.

3. How We Use Your Information
We use the information above to: create and secure your account; show you your feed, picks, and Dugout research tools; grade picks against public game data; process and manage your subscription; send account-related notifications (security alerts, billing receipts, password changes) and, if you opt in, push notifications about picks or activity; respond to support requests; and detect abuse, fraud, or violations of our Terms of Service. We do not sell your personal information to third parties, and we do not use your data to place, facilitate, or influence any real-money wager.
4. How We Share Information
We share information only in these situations: with service providers who process it on our behalf under their own confidentiality obligations (see Section 7); when you make content public per your own visibility settings; to comply with a legal obligation, subpoena, or valid government request; to protect the rights, property, or safety of SlipSurge, our users, or the public; or with your consent. We do not share your information with advertisers or data brokers for their own marketing purposes.
5. Public & Shared Content
Picks, parlays, comments, and posts you create are visible to other users according to the visibility setting you choose for that content — public, followers-only, or private. Your username, avatar, and (unless you enable the hide-win-rate setting) your posted win/loss record are visible on your public profile. Anything you post publicly can be viewed, and potentially re-shared, by anyone — don't post information you wouldn't want to be public.
6. Cookies & Similar Technologies
We use strictly necessary cookies to keep you signed in and to remember basic preferences (like your light/dark theme choice). We do not currently use third-party advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. If that changes, we'll update this section and, where required, ask for your consent first.
7. Third-Party Services We Use

Running SlipSurge means relying on a handful of specialized providers, each of which processes a slice of your data under its own privacy practices:

Authentication, database, and file storage — a third-party provider handles account authentication and stores your account and content data on our behalf.
Subscription billing, creator payments, and membership management are provided by Whop.
Application hosting and delivery — a third-party cloud hosting provider.
Official league data — game schedules, box scores, player bios, and official player headshots/team logos are pulled from a public sports-league data source to power research tools like the Dugout and Slate Breakdown. This is public league data, not information about you.
Sports-data aggregation and public sportsbook lines — we aggregate publicly posted betting odds from major U.S. sportsbooks for display in our research tools, via a third-party sports-data aggregator. SlipSurge is not affiliated with, and does not share your data with, any sportsbook.

Each provider only receives the data it needs to perform its function for us — none of them is authorized to use your data for their own independent purposes.

8. Your Privacy Choices & Rights
Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, export, or delete your personal information, and to object to or restrict certain processing. You can update most account details yourself in Settings, or email support@slipsurge.com for anything else, including a full data export or deletion request. We'll respond within a reasonable time and verify your identity before acting on the request.
9. Data Retention & Deletion
We keep your account data for as long as your account is active, plus a limited period afterward in case you return or a legal/tax obligation requires it. When you delete your account, we delete or anonymize your personal information within a reasonable timeframe, except data we're required to retain by law (e.g. billing records) or that's embedded in another user's content (e.g. a reply to your comment) — that record stays, attributed to a deleted account.
10. Data Security
We use industry-standard safeguards — encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS), hashed passwords, and row-level database access controls that scope every query to the requesting user — to protect your information. No system is 100% secure, so we can't guarantee absolute security. Use a strong, unique password and enable any additional account protection we offer.
11. Children's Privacy
SlipSurge is not directed at, and is not intended for use by, anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18. If we learn we've collected information from a user under 18, we'll delete it. If you believe a child has provided us information, contact support@slipsurge.com.
12. International Users
SlipSurge is operated from the United States and our servers and service providers are primarily based there. If you access the Service from outside the U.S., your information will be transferred to and processed in the U.S., where privacy laws may differ from those in your home country.
13. Changes to This Policy
We may update this policy as the product evolves. If we make a material change, we'll update the "Last updated" date above and, where appropriate, notify you directly. Continued use of the Service after a change means you accept the updated policy.
14. Contact Us
SlipSurge LLC · support@slipsurge.com
Questions about this policy, or a request to access, export, or delete your data, can go to the address above.

Responsible Gambling

Last updated: July 29, 2026 · SlipSurge LLC

SlipSurge is a social and research platform, not a sportsbook. We don't accept wagers, hold funds for betting, or process bets of any kind. Nothing on this site is betting advice or a guarantee of any outcome.
On this page
1. Overview
2. Betting Responsibly
3. Picks & Records Are Not Advice
4. Warning Signs of a Gambling Problem
5. Self-Exclusion Programs
6. Get Help
7. Age Requirement
8. Contact Us
1. Overview
Sports betting can be entertaining when it's done within limits you've set for yourself. This page exists because SlipSurge's community is built around real-money betting culture, even though we ourselves never touch a real wager — and we'd rather you have this information in front of you than assume you've already found it elsewhere.
2. Betting Responsibly
Only bet with licensed, regulated sportsbooks operating legally in your jurisdiction.
Set a budget before you start, and never bet more than you can afford to lose — regardless of what you see posted on SlipSurge or anywhere else.
Set a time limit for how long you'll engage with betting activity in a given session.
Never chase losses by increasing your stakes to win back money you've already lost.
Don't bet under the influence of alcohol or other substances that impair judgment.
Treat betting as entertainment you're paying for, not as a source of income.
Take regular breaks, and don't let betting activity crowd out other parts of your life.
Most licensed sportsbooks offer deposit limits, loss limits, and cool-off/self-exclusion tools directly in their app — use them if you have any doubt about your own limits.
3. Picks & Records Are Not Advice
A user's win/loss record, a hot streak, or a confident-sounding post is not a guarantee of anything. Past results — a user's, or a Custom Matrix's historical hit rate — don't predict future outcomes. Every pick, take, or Matrix result on this platform reflects one person's (or one saved rule's) opinion or history, not financial or betting advice, and SlipSurge doesn't verify that any of it is accurate before it's posted.
4. Warning Signs of a Gambling Problem

Consider stepping back and reaching out for support if you notice yourself:

Betting more money or more often than you intended to;
Lying to family or friends about how much time or money you're spending on betting;
Chasing losses, or betting to escape stress, anxiety, or other problems;
Borrowing money, missing bills, or going into debt to fund betting;
Feeling restless or irritable when trying to cut back or stop; or
Neglecting work, school, relationships, or responsibilities because of betting.

Any one of these on its own is worth paying attention to — you don't need to hit a breaking point before it's worth reaching out for help.

5. Self-Exclusion Programs
If you want to stop yourself from being able to bet, most states run a self-exclusion program that bars you from licensed sportsbooks and casinos statewide — a stronger step than closing an individual sportsbook account, since it's enforced across every licensed operator in that state. The National Council on Problem Gambling maintains a directory of state-by-state self-exclusion programs at ncpgambling.org/help-treatment/self-exclusion.
6. Get Help

If you or someone you know is struggling with gambling, free, confidential help is available 24/7:

Call: 1-800-GAMBLER (1-800-426-2537), the national helpline promoted by the American Gaming Association and most U.S. sportsbooks.
Call or text: 1-800-MY-RESET (1-800-697-3738), the National Problem Gambling Helpline — call, text, or chat, 24/7/365.
Online: ncpgambling.org for chat support and state-by-state resources.
Peer support: gamblersanonymous.org for local Gamblers Anonymous meetings.
7. Age Requirement
You must be at least 18 to create a SlipSurge account. If you intend to place a real-money wager based on anything you see here, you're responsible for confirming you meet the minimum legal age for sports betting in your own jurisdiction — 21 in most U.S. states, and potentially different elsewhere.
8. Contact Us

1. Acceptance of Terms
These Terms of Service ("Terms") are a legal agreement between you and SlipSurge LLC ("SlipSurge," "we," "us") governing your use of slipsurge.com and our mobile apps (together, the "Service"). By creating an account or otherwise using the Service, you agree to these Terms. If you don't agree, don't use the Service.
2. What SlipSurge Is
SlipSurge is a social and research platform for sports bettors — sharing picks, discussing games, and using research tools like the Dugout, Slate Breakdown, and Custom Matrices. SlipSurge is not a sportsbook. We do not accept wagers, hold funds for betting purposes, place bets on your behalf, or pay out on bets. Any odds, wager amounts, or payouts shown on a pick or parlay post are self-reported by the user who posted it and are not verified against, or connected to, any real sportsbook account.
3. Eligibility & Age
You must be at least 18 years old to create a SlipSurge account. If you intend to place a real-money wager with a licensed sportsbook based on anything you see here, you're solely responsible for confirming you meet that sportsbook's and your jurisdiction's minimum age for sports betting — which is 21 in most U.S. states and may be different elsewhere. By using the Service you represent that you meet these requirements.
4. Account Registration & Security
You're responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide when registering, for keeping your login credentials confidential, and for all activity that happens under your account. Tell us immediately at support@slipsurge.com if you suspect unauthorized access. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms, provide false information, or go through unusual account-recovery activity we can't verify.
5. Subscriptions & Billing
Paid memberships, including existing legacy plans, are billed on a recurring basis through Whop. Subscribing unlocks platform features (research tools, feed features, higher-tier content) only — it does not grant any betting product, wagering credit, or guarantee of any outcome. Your subscription renews automatically until you cancel; you can cancel any time from Settings → Membership, and cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period. Refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis — contact support@slipsurge.com.
6. Community Guidelines & Prohibited Conduct

Using the Service, you agree not to:

Post content that's illegal, harassing, threatening, hateful, or that infringes someone else's rights;
Impersonate another person or misrepresent your affiliation with anyone;
Misrepresent your own betting results, or falsify a pick's outcome or odds;
Attempt to access another user's account, scrape the Service at scale, or interfere with its normal operation;
Use the Service to facilitate an actual wager, collect money for betting purposes, or run an unlicensed betting operation; or
Violate any applicable law, including gambling laws in your jurisdiction.

We can remove content or suspend/terminate accounts that violate this section, with or without notice.

7. User Content & License
You retain ownership of the content you post (picks, comments, posts, images). By posting, you grant SlipSurge a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to host, store, display, reproduce, and distribute that content within the Service — including showing it to other users per your chosen visibility setting, and generating a shareable image/preview of a post you create. This license ends when you delete the content or your account, except where it's been re-shared by another user or where we need to retain a copy for legal or safety reasons.
8. Intellectual Property
The SlipSurge name, logo, and the Service's design, software, and original content are owned by SlipSurge LLC and protected by intellectual property law — you may not copy, modify, or reverse-engineer any part of it outside normal use of the Service. Team logos, player photos, and certain statistical data displayed on the Service are sourced from a public sports-league data source and remain the property of the applicable league and its member clubs; we display them for informational and statistical purposes only.
9. Third-Party Services & Data
The Service displays sports data, statistics, and betting odds aggregated from third-party sources, including public league data feeds, a sports-data aggregator, and publicly posted sportsbook lines. We do our best to keep this data accurate and current, but we don't control these sources and can't guarantee their accuracy, availability, or timeliness. SlipSurge is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by any sports league, club, or sportsbook referenced on the Service.
10. No Betting, Financial, or Investment Advice
Nothing on SlipSurge — including picks, records, win rates, Custom Matrix results, or odds data — is financial, investment, or betting advice, and none of it guarantees any outcome. A user's past performance, however it's displayed, does not predict future results. If you choose to bet, do so only with a licensed, regulated sportsbook in your jurisdiction, and only with money you can afford to lose. See our Responsible Gambling page.
11. Disclaimers; No Warranty
The Service is provided "as is" and "as available," without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement. We don't guarantee the Service will be uninterrupted, error-free, or secure, or that any statistic, odds line, or pick grading will be accurate.
12. Limitation of Liability
To the maximum extent permitted by law, SlipSurge LLC and its officers, employees, and service providers won't be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for any loss of profits, data, or gambling losses, arising from your use of (or inability to use) the Service — even if we've been advised of the possibility of such damages. Our total liability for any claim related to the Service is limited to the amount you paid us in the twelve months before the claim arose, or $100, whichever is greater.
13. Indemnification
You agree to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless SlipSurge LLC from any claim, loss, or expense (including reasonable legal fees) arising from your use of the Service, your content, or your violation of these Terms or any law.
14. Termination
You can stop using the Service and delete your account at any time from Settings → Account. We may suspend or terminate your access to the Service, at our discretion, for violating these Terms, for extended inactivity, or to comply with a legal obligation. Sections that by their nature should survive termination (e.g. Intellectual Property, Limitation of Liability, Indemnification, Dispute Resolution) will continue to apply after your account is closed.
15. Governing Law & Dispute Resolution
These Terms are governed by the laws of the state in which SlipSurge LLC is organized, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. Before filing any formal claim, you agree to contact us at support@slipsurge.com so we can try to resolve the dispute informally first.
16. Miscellaneous
If any part of these Terms is found unenforceable, the rest remains in effect. These Terms, along with our Privacy Policy, are the entire agreement between you and SlipSurge regarding the Service. We may assign these Terms in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets; you may not assign your rights under these Terms without our consent.
17. Changes to These Terms
We may update these Terms as the product evolves. If we make a material change, we'll update the "Last updated" date above and, where appropriate, notify you directly. Continued use of the Service after a change means you accept the updated Terms.
